segments.name: 01_F00-F05
segments.prompt: Use case: sketch-to-render. Production HD transparent 2D game sprite sheet. Image 1 is the exact SIX FRAME POSE edit target. Image 2 is the material style reference only. Repaint Image 1 with Image 2's finely hand-painted intertwining olive-green woody vine fibers, dark green shadows, restrained leaf clusters and pale green volume highlights. The image must have exactly THREE COLUMNS and TWO ROWS of equal SQUARE cells, SIX complete isolated sprites read left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Output 1536x1024 pixels, with each sprite in a 512x512 square cell. Keep EACH input pose silhouette, relative size, location, curve and two-vine identity EXACT, do not invent movements. One common root pivot at cell coordinate (110,448), soil baseline y448, with transparent padding underneath. Two SLENDER flexible tapered vines anchored together, not bulky tree trunks, bamboo, snakes or rigid poles. Preserve source body's width-to-length proportions; do not fatten or merge the distinct whips. Keep constant arc length across poses; lower stem accelerates first, upper portion trails the previous direction, delayed second vine strikes later. Smooth finely rendered edges and longitudinal bark detail, no chunky pixel blocks or nearest-neighbor upscaling. Just the vine bodies and tiny source soil, no backdrop, no baked glow or afterimages, no labels, numbers, borders, checkerboards, watermarks, scene objects or characters. Genuine transparent alpha. No pixels cross a cell boundary. Roots stay at the same position in all six cells. Image 2 now defines the FINAL slender braided vine design: copy its two separate finely rendered strands, small attached pointed leaves, muted olive/gold highlights and warm tiny soil clod. These six frames are F00-F05 EARLY GROWTH ONLY, not full-height poses. Top-left: tiny soil clod, absolutely NO vine. Top-middle: only a very tiny green bud emerges (6 source pixels tall). Top-right: short baby pair emerges (18 source pixels tall). Bottom-left: pair has grown 38 source pixels tall. Bottom-middle: 66 source pixels tall. Bottom-right: 102 source pixels tall (about two thirds of eventual 160 source pixel full length). Keep exactly those normalized heights as shown in Image 1, same root, same thickness taper design, slim vines growing VERTICALLY out of soil. Do not fill the cells with full-height upright vines. All motion grows from ground at y87.5% inside each cell. Real transparent alpha, no diffuse glow or RGB gradient background visible in alpha.

alpha_cleanup_prompt: Background-extraction edit of the attached SIX-frame vine sprite atlas. KEEP ALL SIX painted vine poses, root clods, little soil fragments, material details, dimensions and 3x2 cell placement exactly unchanged. Remove ALL of the diffuse olive green/brown/black gradients, haze, shadows, glow and ambient background across the entire image, including inside the vine loops. Only solid vine bodies, their attached leaves and the tiny soil clods remain. The entire negative space must have alpha=0 (real transparency), not dark green, black, white, checkerboard or a low opacity glow. No painted background whatsoever. Antialiased cutout edges are allowed within ONE pixel of the vine edges, nowhere else. Preserve the original vine RGB colors, don't darken them. Return the same 1536x1024 RGBA sprite atlas on actual transparent alpha.
